verdict.rationale: Docs show schema-validated structured output: a Pydantic model passed as `output_type` forces the model to return data matching the spec, and agents are typed by output type (e.g. `Agent[Foobar, list[str]]`). Automatic retries on validation failure are never documented in the pack; they are only implied by a community comment that mentions retries. Hands-on reports are mixed: one user says structured output is on par with instructor, while others report frequent object-creation failures despite retries and broken structured output on Azure OpenAI. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of automatic validation-failure retries (configuration, retry limits, error feedback to the model), and consistent independent confirmation that validation and retries work reliably across providers.
